observation: Captured via corrected precompileProbe + lootTableId=mule_trader hook on ship_kestrel (draws 20/19/18, radius 3.94, size 6.55 x 1.86 x 3.98 WU, 0 errors; scaled 6/20 vs DESIGN_RADIUS 20 due to fleetLook def.radius || 6). Clean cream-and-gold corporate livery (Meridian_Hull, Meridian_Container 1024x1024 PBR+normal) and 2x3 modular container grid give immediate corporate-hauler identity. Yet close and inspect show concrete attachment and glow defects: (1) Meridian_NavLight_Port and Meridian_NavLight_Starboard ([10.5, 1.4, +/-2.6]) float completely detached in empty space well outside the tapered nose (halfY~0.97, halfZ~1.51 at x=10.5); (2) Meridian_Brand_Port/Starboard ([4.5, 2.8] at [4.0, 0.4, +/-3.01]) and Meridian_Dock_Wear ([10.0, 3.0] at [-4.0, 0.4, 3.01]) extend past the curved hull taper, visibly poking out as thin floating card edges in close and inspect; (3) Meridian_Container_Cap_* faces (Meridian_Gold emissiveIntensity 1.2) turn the front face of every cargo cube into a solid glowing yellow square; (4) twin Meridian_Drive_* nozzles at x=-9.2 sit mostly buried inside the x=-9.0 stern cap, and Meridian_Radiator_* / Meridian_Service_Grid are sharp un-beveled boxes. Explicit lod2 was not captured.
decision: disposition: needs follow-up — detached floating Meridian_NavLight_* blocks in empty space off the nose, protruding floating Meridian_Brand_* and Meridian_Dock_Wear decal card edges, solid glowing Meridian_Container_Cap_* faces, and buried aft Meridian_Drive_* nozzles.
next: Anchor Meridian_NavLight_* onto the bow hull contour, fit Meridian_Brand_* and Meridian_Dock_Wear decals inside the hull flank bounds, replace solid glowing container end faces with recessed indicator strips, clear Meridian_Drive_* nozzles behind the stern cap, verify at nominal scale and lod2, and recapture.
